trackerLog.subject: Asteria

feature.title: Runtime stack: Godot 4, GDScript / GDExtension, PC and Deck first
feature.notes: Engine Godot 4. Game code GDScript; GDExtension for later hot loops only. Year-one ship targets Windows, Linux, Steam Deck. Consoles later, not a year-one gate. Presentation remains FEAT-046 plates+sprites; not realtime 3D. Gameplay ships as act modules or act-group modules. Act 0 (FEAT-013) is the first standalone act module. This ticket specifies the stack. It does not start a build and does not close FEAT-009.

trackerLog.decision: Runtime lock: Godot 4, GDScript / GDExtension, PC and Steam Deck first.
Acts ship as modules. Act 0 is the first standalone act module. No build started from this lock.
FEAT-009 stays open. Board pack is not closed by the runtime lock.
